name: Shucchou♪ Shirogane Gakuen Maid-bu
original_name: 出張♪しろがね学園メイド部
source:
Maid club had to dissolve when one of its three members quit it. But now there's an energetic newcomer whose presence allows to revive the club. Club does "field training" activities with all school's boys as customers.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-july-2002-viper-rsr.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
女仆俱乐部因三名成员之一退出而不得不解散。但现在有一位充满活力的新人的出现让俱乐部重获新生。俱乐部以所有学校男生为顾客进行“实地训练”活动。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-july-2002-viper-rsr.html]vndbreview[/url]]
